about_the_game:
Sometimes the best adventures are the ones you can taste.

The Furry Do Porn – Lollipop DLC brings more than 50 brand new uncensored animations to satisfy players with a craving for candy-coated fun. This time it’s all about licking, sucking, and savoring — a sugary side quest for those who like their pleasures sweet and sticky.

If the main game left you drooling, this expansion is here to finish the job. Whether you’re here for the licks, the pops, or the sticky aftermath, Lollipop delivers nonstop oral delight in the only way furries know how — unashamed, uncensored, and over the top.

Highlights:

  • 50+ new explicit furry animations added to your collection

  • A sugary-sweet expansion focused on licking and sucking action

  • Fully integrated with the base game, no extra fuss

  • Made for those who prefer dessert first

⚠️ Note: This DLC adds new content to the base game. You must own Furry Do Porn to enjoy the Lollipop experience.
